sample_read: Slurm job 919175 read one epoched EEGLAB SET/FDT pair from each study. Header job 919218 then matched all 59 SET/FDT/block-metadata stems without opening FDT signal data.
notes: The release contains 59 SET, 59 FDT, 59 block_dt MAT and one TXT file (178 total).
Observed study recording counts are 5, 15, 10, 15 and 14; there are six channel layouts, 80-89 channels and 100, 200 or 256 Hz sampling.

All delivered SET metadata expose only trial blocks 1 and 2; study05 has no trial_ids. This does not directly match the paper-level three-block EEGDS4 description, so study-to-paper mapping remains unresolved.
No verified clean EEG target exists, so this dataset is evaluation-only unless a separate compatible prior transfer is registered.
